physDesc.additional: Script: 'bru tsha. Numbering in letters in the left margin on the recto, only visible on fol. 2, fol. 3 and fol. 7 Orthography: - Use of bindu for m - Palatalization of m (e.g., myi, myed) with some exceptions - Particle pa/ba sometimes takes the form pa after final –ng - Rare superabundant 'a rjes 'jug (e.g., gzhi') Lemmas of the base text as sublinear notes.

bde ba'i 'byung gnas bstan pa'i don du bsngo ba dang | [55] bka' drin rjes su dran pa phyag 'tshal ba'o |
gzhan don du bsngo ba la gnyis ste | [521] 'jig rten pa'i don du bsngo ba dang | [522] 'jig rten las 'das pa'i don du bsngo ba'o |
dang po la gsuM ste | [521.1] spyir bsngo ba dang | [521.2] ngan 'gro'i don du bsngo ba dang | [521.3] bde 'gro'i don du bsngo ba'o |
gnyis pa la gsuM ste | [521.21] dgyal ba dang | [521.22] dud 'gro dang | [521.23] yid dags kyi don bsngo ba'o |
dang po la gnyis
ste | [521.211] sdug bsngal rang zhi ba dang | [521.212.1] phyag na rdo rje'i stobs dang | [521.212.2] spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi thugs rje dang | [521.212.3] 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi cho 'phrul dang| [521.212.4] nye ba'i sras gzhan gyi nus pas zhi ba bzhis [521.212] gzhan gyi mthus zhi pa'o ||
rang zhi ba la gsuM ste | [521.211.1] spyir zhe ba dang | [521.211.21] grang ba'i dmyal ba'i zhi ba dang | [521.211.22] tsha ba'i dmyal ba'i zhi ba gnyis kyis [521.211.2] gzhi'i sdug bsngal zhi ba dang | [521.211.31] shing gi gnod pa dang | [521.211.32] bya'i gnod
pa dang | [521.211.33] gzhi' gnod pa dang | [521.211.34] chu'i gnod pa zhi ba bzhis [521.211.3] nye 'khro gyi sdug bsngal zhi pa'o ||
mtho ris gyi don du bsngo ba la gnyis ste | dbang po ma tshang ba'i sdug bsngal dang | ma la gyi dug rdu myed pa dang | dbul ba'i sdug bsngal myed pa dang | yid myi bde ba'i sdug bsgnal dang | na ba'i sdug bsngal pa dang | sdang ba dang phrad pa'i sdug bsngal pa dang | 'dron pa'i sdug bsngal dang | mi sa yin pa'i gnod
pa las thar pa brgyad gyis [521.31] myi 'dod pa dang bral ba dang | [521.32] 'dod pa'i don grub par bsngo ba'o |
de la gnyis ste | [521.321]spyir myi 'i don du bsngo ba dang | dge 'dun gyi don du bsngo pa dang | dge slong gi don du bsngo ba dang | dge slong ma'i don bsngo pa dang| tshul khrims phun suM 'tshogs par bsngo pa dang | 'bras bu bde pa la * spyod par bsngo ba lngas [521.322] bye brag du rab tu byung ba'i don du bsngo ba'o ||
spyir myi'i don du bsngo ba la gsuM ste |
'jig rten pa'i phun suM 'tshogs pa 'thob pa dang | longs spyod phun suM 'tshogs pa thob pa dang | 'tshengs myed pa dang | gsi brjid phun sum 'tshogs pa dang | g*ugs phun suM 'tshogs pa dang | dman pa mchog du gyur pa dang | dge ba phun suM 'tshogs pa bdun yis [521.321.1] phun suM 'tshogs pa thob pa dang | bsaM pa dang | spyor ba dang | 'byung rkyen tshang ba dang | 'gal rkyen myed pa bzhis [521.321.2] yang dag pa'i laM la 'jug pa dang
'tshe ba yun ring pa dang | snod gyi 'jig rten dag pa dang | bcud rnam par dag pa dang | dge ba yod pa dang | 'byor pa'i * byed phun suM 'tshogs pa dang | gnod pa'i zhi ba drug gis [521.321.3]'byor ba bde bar 'byor pa'o |: |
'jig rten las 'das pa'i don du bsngo ba la gsum ste | byang chub sems dpa' dang | sangs rgyas dang | nyan thos dang rang rgyal ba'i don du bsngo ba'o ||||

byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug
pa'i don bsdus pa dge slong chos kyi seng ges nye bar sbyar pa rdzogs s+h+yo ||
